result.title: Evidence-Aligned Benchmarking and Learning for Medical Video Language Models
result.summary: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about. We find three places where this breaks down and address each with an approach we call MedEvidU. First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric. We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings. Second, common video encoders merge consecutive frames into shared tokens, so a question about one frame is answered from a blend of two. Query-slot inputs give each queried frame its own tokens at almost no extra cost. Third, a fine-tuned model has memorized its training questions, which leaves little to learn from. Label-matched question resampling (LQR) adds unseen questions about the same recordings while keeping the answer distribution fixed, in a final supervised epoch and in reinforcement learning. Together, these raise the grounding IoU of a 4B model from 30.4 to 44.4, above a supervised 27B model, and instrument grounding at an unseen hospital from 33.9 to 72.5. On blindly cut windows, event-presence accuracy improves by 5.5 points and localization F1 by 8.1 points. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对医学视频语言模型答非所视的问题提出 MedEvidU：构建经「无视频作答」审计的基准 MedVidBench-v2，用 query-slot 让被问帧独占 token，并以标签匹配问题重采样减少记忆，从而提升视觉证据定位与跨医院泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其诊断的三类失效——位置先验与恒定答案即可刷分、帧间 token 合并使证据混杂、微调后只记住训练问题——正对应 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、内部状态信息坍缩与证据筛选，基准审计与逐帧 token 设计可供核查借鉴。
